title: Supplemental Bible Fragments — Angels, Eyes, Wings & Sprouts
translation: World English Bible (WEB) unless otherwise noted
purpose: Supply short exact or tightly scoped public-domain scripture fragments for the angel/eye/wing/sprout contextual reader.

fragments.text: The cherubim shall spread out their wings upward ... There I will meet with you ... from between the two cherubim.
Above him stood the seraphim. Each one had six wings.
Their whole body ... their hands, their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes all around.
The four living creatures, each one of them having six wings, are full of eyes around and within.
Aren’t they all serving spirits, sent out to do service for the sake of those who will inherit salvation?
Praise Yahweh, you angels of his ... you servants of his, who do his pleasure.
A shoot will come out of the stock of Jesse, and a branch out of his roots will bear fruit.
Behold, the man whose name is the Branch ... he will build Yahweh’s temple.
